The evidence explicitly states in the notes section: 'mantissaBitIdx: Controls cell size per level. Starts at 22, decrements by 1 per level. Cell size = exp2(mantissaBitIdx - 23).' Additionally, the code snippet provided in the notes shows the calculation: `float cellSize = uintBitsToFloat((127 + mantissaBitIdx - 23) << 23);`. In IEEE-754 single-precision floating-point representation, setting the exponent bits to `(127 + mantissaBitIdx - 23)` and the mantissa bits to 0 results in the value $2^{(127 + mantissaBitIdx - 23) - 127} = 2^{mantissaBitIdx - 23}$. Therefore, the claim that this effectively computes $2^{mantissaBitIdx - 23}$ is fully supported by the evidence.
